reports.question: AWS 的经营利润率会在接下来五年里超过 40% 吗？

en.title: Will the AWS operating margin clear 40% in the next five years?
en.summary: Three settlements answered separately, because they are different questions. A rebuilt thirty-quarter segment series, a depreciation model computed two independent ways, and the finding that 1.4 points of the headline margin are an energy-contract accounting gain.
en.metaTitle: AWS five-year operating margin forecast — Predict Raven
en.metaDescription: As of September 18, 2026: a 65% probability that the AWS segment operating margin exceeds 40% in at least one of the next twenty quarters, 22% for a full fiscal year, and 25% that it holds above 40% for four consecutive quarters.
en.frameTitle: Full AWS five-year operating margin forecast in Chinese

zh-CN.title: AWS 的利润率会在五年内超过 40% 吗？
zh-CN.summary: 三个口径分开回答，因为它们是难度完全不同的三道题。重建了三十个季度的分部序列，用两种互相独立的方法测算折旧，并发现报出来的利润率里有 1.4 个百分点来自电力合约的会计收益。
zh-CN.metaTitle: AWS 五年经营利润率能否超过 40% — Predict Raven
zh-CN.metaDescription: 截至 2026 年 9 月 18 日，AWS 分部经营利润率在未来二十个季度中至少一个季度超过 40% 的概率为 65%，某个完整财年超过 40% 的概率为 22%，连续四个季度站稳 40% 以上的概率为 25%。
zh-CN.frameTitle: AWS 五年经营利润率完整中文报告
